name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
_comment_k_active: 6 routed experts + 1 shared expert (always active). Shared expert approximated by k=7.
_comment_caveats: Architecture-specific extensions NOT modeled: Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA), Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA), Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head with num_nextn_predict_layers=1, sliding_window=128 on attention. These reduce real per-token compute and KV traffic vs the framework's MLA + MoE generic forms; predicted decode latency is therefore an upper bound.
_comment: The input embedding and the LM head are separate matrices in the published weights (`tied_embeddings` false), so memory holds two vocabulary matrices.
_comment_attention: Attention shape taken from the published weights, as an explicit shape (not the DeepSeek-V3 latent form): 128 query heads of width 512 reached through a rank-1536 query path (7168 -> 1536 -> 65536), ONE key/value vector of width 512 per token shared by all heads (7168 -> 512), and an output path of 16 groups (4096 -> 1024 each) followed by 16384 -> 7168. That is 299,892,736 projection parameters per layer, a cache of 512 elements per token per layer, and a score/value width of 65,536. The cache is not split by head, so under TP-attention every rank holds all of it.
